Portraits can only be hung next to other portraits, and you'll need to think ahead to optimize their placement in order to chain matches and not strand any. Once you've run out of space on the wall, the game will end.

- Play as either the Smiths or the Joneses.
- Numbered Portraits accessibility mode.
- A sticker pack for iMessage! Who among us hasn't wanted to drop a minus heart on a text message?
